suites.title: Analytics Events
suites.description: Which screens and actions are tracked, and which known gaps exist today.

cases.title: Only certain screens log a screen view — check which ones do and don't

steps.action: Visit Welcome, the three onboarding steps, My Path, Resources, Calendar, Explore, and a task's resource feed.
steps.expected_result: Each one logs a screen view.

steps.action: Visit the task list, task detail, a category's detail screen, and the More tab.
steps.expected_result: None of these four log a screen view today. Confirm with the team whether that's expected before treating it as a bug.

cases.title: Tracked actions log with the correct, exact name every time

steps.action: Trigger each tracked action once: tapping Let's Go!, finishing Step 1, picking or unpicking a goal, adding a category from Explore, finishing onboarding, opening a task, completing a task, viewing a resource, opening a resource, and setting a reminder.
steps.expected_result: Each one logs under its correct name, consistently, every time it happens.

cases.title: Opening a local directory link is tracked the same way as opening a resource

steps.action: Tap a local directory link on the Resources tab.
steps.expected_result: It logs as an opened resource, tagged as a directory. There's a separate "directory opened" tracking type defined that isn't actually used here — flag this as a known gap for the team, not a bug.

cases.title: Calling a hotline isn't tracked as its own distinct action yet

steps.action: Tap the Call button on a hotline resource.
steps.expected_result: It logs as an opened resource and a viewed resource. There's a separate "helpline called" tracking type defined that isn't wired up to this yet — flag this as a known gap.

cases.title: "Resource saved" and "category added" tracking types aren't wired up either

steps.action: Try every action in Resources and Explore that sounds like it should "save" something, including adding a category to your path.
steps.expected_result: Adding a category logs correctly under its own name. Two other tracking types exist in the system for "resource saved" and "category added" but neither one ever actually logs — flag both as known gaps.

cases.title: Tasks are tracked under My Path even though their own screens don't log a view

steps.action: Open a task and mark it complete.
steps.expected_result: The completion is tracked and labeled as happening on the My Path screen, even though the task list and task detail screens don't log their own separate screen view. Confirm with the team this is intentional grouping, not a mislabeling bug.

suites.title: Network / Interruption / Device-State
suites.description: What happens when the connection drops, the app is backgrounded, or the device changes state.

cases.title: Losing connection shows a clear error on every main screen, not a crash

steps.action: Turn on airplane mode, then open My Path, Resources, Explore, and Calendar for the first time this session.
steps.expected_result: Each one shows its own clear "couldn't load, try again" message instead of crashing or spinning forever.

steps.action: Turn airplane mode off and retry each screen.
steps.expected_result: Each one loads normally without needing to restart the app.

cases.title: Backgrounding the app during video playback stops the sound

steps.action: Start a video playing, then put the app in the background.
steps.expected_result: The video stops playing — it doesn't keep playing sound with the screen off.

steps.action: Bring the app back to the foreground.
steps.expected_result: Only one video resumes (or waits for a tap) — never two overlapping sounds.

cases.title: Backgrounding mid-save doesn't silently lose the change

steps.action: Start marking a task complete, saving an appointment, or saving an onboarding step, then immediately background the app before it finishes.
steps.expected_result: Either the save completes anyway, or it fails and shows an error when you come back — it never looks saved on screen while nothing actually saved.

cases.title: Changing your time zone updates on the next visit to My Path

steps.action: Change your device's time zone, then reopen or revisit My Path.
steps.expected_result: Your saved time zone updates automatically — no need to redo onboarding or reinstall.

cases.title: Resizing the window doesn't break the resource feed

steps.action: On a web browser, resize the window while viewing the task resource feed.
steps.expected_result: Swiping still moves exactly one resource at a time, and videos resize correctly to fit.

cases.title: A slow device doesn't let you accidentally advance onboarding twice

steps.action: On a slow device, fill in Step 1 and tap Next several times quickly while it's saving.
steps.expected_result: Only one save actually goes through, and you're only moved forward once.

cases.title: Closing the app mid-onboarding starts over rather than resuming halfway

steps.expected_result:
See "Reentry Roadmap" within 30s
Don't see "Tell us about yourself"

cases.title: A dropped connection while a YouTube video is loading eventually shows an error

steps.action: Start loading a YouTube video, then cut the connection before it finishes loading.
steps.expected_result: It eventually shows an error rather than spinning forever. If it does spin forever, flag this as a known gap — there's no visible timeout for this case.

cases.title: Backgrounding and foregrounding the app doesn't double-log a screen view

steps.action: Background the app and immediately bring it back while staying on the same screen.
steps.expected_result: No duplicate screen-view is logged just from that — it should only log when you actually open or return to a screen.

steps.expected_result: None of them stop you from finishing onboarding, adding a goal, completing a task, or viewing any resource — they're minor tracking or edge-case gaps, not blockers, and should be reported to the team as a simple list rather than urgent bugs.
